hero.title: Executive MBA in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: An Executive Master of Business Administration (Executive MBA or EMBA) is a postgraduate business qualification targeted principally at professionals, managers, entrepreneurs and business leaders who desire to enhance their leadership, strategic planning and decision making skills. **Executive MBA in Mauritius** is an option for working professionals who want to strengthen their business knowledge and develop leadership capabilities while progressing in their careers.

overview: Mauritius also has Executive MBA programs for students wishing to pursue higher business studies. Amity Institute of Higher Education, for example, lists a 16-month, full-time Executive MBA, while the University of Mauritius lists a two-year, part-time MBA and specialized MBA programs. These are different program formats and applicants are advised to compare entry requirements, fees, teaching schedules and recognition before making a choice. Students researching an **Executive MBA in Mauritius for Indian Students** should also check international admission conditions and the exact qualification awarded.

faq.question: What is the duration of Executive MBA in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Amity Institute of Higher Education offers a 16 month full-time Executive MBA. The University of Mauritius offers a two-year part-time MBA and Middlesex University Mauritius offers a one-year full-time or two-year part-time MBA. The last two are MBA alternatives and not specifically named Executive MBA programs.

faq.question: How much does an Executive MBA cost in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Amity charges MUR 130,000 for domestic and SADC students and US\$ 3,000 for international students. Fees at other institutions vary according to the program and student category, so please check the latest fee schedule before applying.

faq.question: Do you need work experience to do an Executive MBA?
faq.answer: Requirements differ. To be eligible for Amity’s published Executive MBA program, candidates must have a bachelor’s degree and a minimum of two years of professional work experience, or equivalent under its mature-admissions policy. Please check current requirements before applying.

faq.question: Is it possible for Indian students to do an Executive MBA in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Indian students can apply if they fulfilll the programme’s educational and professional requirements. They should check the international tuition fee, the recognition of the qualification, the application deadlines and the study permit requirements that apply.

faq.question: What is the difference between an MBA and Executive MBA?
faq.answer: An MBA is a general post-graduate business/management degree. Executive MBA is typically designed for working professionals, who have some work experience and want to develop leadership and strategic skills, building on their existing career experience. However, program structures and entry requirements vary so you should compare the actual course details and not just the title.
